fichas.title: Garden Pond
fichas.summary: Guidance for siting and planting garden ponds, establishing biological balance, selecting pond size and depth zones, excavating and lining the pond, and protecting aquatic life in winter. Diagrams show stepped planting, a prefabricated pond, excavation, edge construction, and a stream cross-section.
uses: Create a habitat for aquatic plants, insects, newts, and other wildlife
Provide a naturalistic garden water feature
